text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa got injured during 
training, so I brought her to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geez. Trainer, you worry too much, YES~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this is no big deal at all, 
I'm telling you-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As long as I get my medicine real quick, I 
can go right back to training, yes!
choice_data_list: Let's power through and get well soon!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, guess so, desu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, is there no training that 
won't affect my injury, yes?
choice_data_list: Do you really want to train that much?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Just as fish need water, El 
desperately needs training, desu!
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, you'll have to rest even 
longer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'd hate that, but... Grrrgh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. But as soon as I'm healed, 
we are going straight to training, yes, 
desu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having taken a proper rest, El Condor Pasa 
was able to resume training within just a 
few days.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Guts! Leave it to me! Guts is El's 
specialty!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh! ¡Aguántate! El can do this, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa was about to leap into 
action with a shout, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No way!? Are you saying El doesn't have 
enough guts……!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh... El is so down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems guts alone weren't enough. To be 
safe, we dedicated the rest of the day to 
rest.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Guts! Leave it to me! Guts is El's 
specialtyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! ¡Aguántate! El should be able to 
do this, deeeesu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as the call sounded, El Condor Pasa 
sprang into motion—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Seems the pain has faded...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! ¡Estupendo! I got all better through 
sheer guts, YES!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, at this rate, it looks like 
I'll be ready to train in no time, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Displaying phenomenal regenerative powers, 
El Condor Pasa recovered enough to resume 
training the very next day.
